title: Senior Unity Developer
description:

Our excitement about the vision and mission of the company has enabled us to foster a great culture and an exciting work environment that is based on building synergies and our team’s exceptional talent to make our customers’ experience outstanding.
Your Impact
The Senior Unity Developer role is based in Jordan and reports to the Software Engineering Head and will be responsible for designing and implementing robust, reusable components and systems within Unity. This includes developing high-quality, modular Unity packages that can be seamlessly integrated into various applications across multiple projects. The role demands deep expertise in Unity's graphics and UI development capabilities, performance optimization, shader programming, and the application of best practices in modular and scalable design.
What You'll Do
Design and build modular, reusable Unity components using SOLID principles, dependency injection, and event-driven architecture.
Package components to ensure easy integration, versioning, and dependency management across multiple projects.
Maintain a focus on creating project-agnostic components by avoiding project-specific dependencies.
Design and develop intuitive and high-performance UI elements for both 2D and 3D interactive applications.
Work on optimizing UI experiences for VR and AR environments.
Implement animations and interactive elements that are responsive and engaging.
Develop custom shaders using various shader languages like HLSL and Shader Graph for a variety of platforms, including URP and HDRP.
Optimize shaders and graphical assets to ensure high performance across both mobile and high-performance platforms.
Implement advanced graphics techniques to meet the needs of both 2D/3D graphics and VR/AR applications.
Provide thorough documentation for all Unity packages, including setup instructions and API references.
Create sample scenes that demonstrate how to implement and use the reusable components in different Unity projects.
Ensure clear, detailed guides are available for developers on how to best use the components.
Develop and maintain automated unit and integration tests for all components to ensure quality and stability.
Collaborate with the DevOps team to set up continuous integration (CI) workflows to validate components across different Unity versions and project environments.
Regularly test components for performance and ensure cross-platform compatibility.
Collaborate with other developers, designers, and product teams to ensure the effective integration of reusable components into larger projects.
Mentor junior developers, providing guidance and support in best practices for Unity development, code architecture, and performance optimization.
Adhere to the quality standards and safety procedures as per the company guidelines and local regulations.
Take appropriate actions in relation to any hazards and work related issues, and escalate as needed, in order to ensure prompt and effective resolution.
Perform other job-related tasks as assigned by the line manager, in order to ensure the fulfillment of organizational objectives.
What To Bring
Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Software Development, or a related field.
5+ years of experience developing applications using Unity.
Strong proficiency in C#.
Solid understanding of clean code practices and clean architecture.
Knowledge of component-based design.
Familiarity with Git and version control workflows.
Good understanding of 3D mathematics, including vectors, matrices, and trigonometry.
Strong understanding and practical application of SOLID principles.
Experience with modular and scalable systems, graphics optimization, and shader programming.
Experience with VR/AR development, CI/CD pipelines, cross-platform development, and automated testing is preferred.
Familiarity with the Domain-Driven Design (DDD) programming paradigm is a plus.
What We Offer
Great culture and growth opportunity
The chance to personally impact Eon’s customer experience
Push your boundaries working with highly motivated and cross-functional teams
Interested?

title: Android Developer
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a hands-on Android Developer with strong native Android experience in Java. The role is suited for someone who can build reliable mobile features, work with Android platform APIs, debug on real devices, and handle real-time data from sensors, location, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and other device-level sources.
The ideal candidate should be practical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working on features where data may be noisy, delayed, stale, or device-dependent. This is not only a UI development role; it requires platform-level Android thinking, strong debugging habits, and the ability to improve behaviour through testing, logs, and real-device validation.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain native Android features using Java, Android Studio, Gradle, and standard Android development practices.
Work with Android lifecycle, permissions, services, foreground/background behaviour, receivers, timers, callbacks, and resource cleanup.
Build real-time mobile features involving sensors, location, movement tracking, device APIs, maps, and continuously changing data.
Integrate with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, location, SensorManager, and other Android platform or hardware-related APIs where required.
Process and validate noisy or unreliable data streams using practical logic such as smoothing, confidence checks, stale-data handling, jump rejection, and fallback states.
Debug issues on actual Android devices using Logcat, Android Studio tools, crash logs, profiling, reproducible test cases, and device-specific investigation.
Optimize application performance, battery usage, responsiveness, memory management, and background execution behaviour.
Write clean, modular, maintainable code that can be safely integrated into an existing codebase.
Collaborate with backend, frontend/cross-platform, QA, and product teams to deliver stable mobile features.
Document technical assumptions, edge cases, debugging findings, and implementation decisions clearly.
Required Skills & Experience
2–4 years of hands-on Android development experience, preferably with native Android using Java.
Strong understanding of Android fundamentals including Activity/Fragment lifecycle, services, BroadcastReceivers, permissions, threading, and background execution limits.
Practical experience with Java in Android projects, including clean code structure, error handling, interfaces/classes, callbacks/listeners, and maintainable module design.
Experience debugging Android applications on real devices, not only emulators.
Understanding of runtime permissions for location, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi/device APIs, and graceful handling of denied or unavailable permissions.
Ability to work with asynchronous flows, delayed responses, API timeouts, retries, and failure states.
Good understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication flows, and mobile-backend integration.
Awareness of memory leaks, listener cleanup, long-running callbacks, battery impact, UI jank, and performance bottlenecks.
Comfortable using Git and working in an existing team codebase.
Good to Have
Kotlin knowledge or ability to read and modify Kotlin code when required.
Hands-on exposure to Android sensors such as accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, orientation, or barometer.
Experience with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, scanning APIs, device capability checks, and Android OS restrictions.
Experience with maps, live marker movement, tracking, navigation, positioning, or route-related mobile features.
Basic understanding of data filtering concepts such as moving average, median filter, low-pass filtering, confidence scoring, outlier rejection, and smoothing-vs-lag trade-offs.
Experience creating or maintaining React Native native Android modules.
Exposure to Firebase Crashlytics, analytics, logs, performance profiling, or similar mobile observability tools.
Candidate Profile
Strong practical problem-solver who can reason through unstable or device-dependent behaviour.
Comfortable testing on physical Android devices and investigating differences across OS versions and hardware models.
Does not treat algorithms or filters as “magic fixes”; understands trade-offs between smoothness, responsiveness, accuracy, and battery usage.
Can separate source-data issues from processing logic, state updates, UI rendering, and network/API delays.
Takes ownership of debugging, logging, documentation, and incremental improvement rather than relying on guesswork.
Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical team members.
What Success Looks Like
Reliable Android features that work consistently across real devices and OS versions.
Clean handling of noisy, stale, delayed, or low-confidence data without creating unstable user experiences.
Good logs and debugging visibility for device-level issues.
Balanced decisions around performance, battery, responsiveness, and accuracy.
Maintainable code that other developers can understand and extend.
How to Apply
Interested candidates may send their updated CV to hr@dcsys.xyz with the subject line:
Android Developer Application – [Candidate Name]
.
Please include relevant Android projects, examples of real-device debugging experience, and any experience with sensors, location, BLE/Wi-Fi APIs, maps, or real-time mobile features.

title: React Native Mobile Engineer (Proptech)
description:
Location:
On Site (Dubai)
Tech Stack:
Swift (iOS) / Kotlin (Android) — migrating to React Native
Salary:
AED 15,000 + performance-based bonus
About the Role
OWNRSCLB currently has separate native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps. Our strategic decision is to consolidate onto a single React Native codebase - one team, one product, both platforms.
We are looking for a React Native engineer who can maintain and stabilise the existing native apps through launch, then lead the migration to React Native over the following 6-12 months. You will be the sole mobile engineer on the team, which means real ownership and real impact.
This is not a role for someone who needs close supervision. You will be trusted to make the right mobile decisions, flag risks early, and deliver quality product on two platforms simultaneously during the transition period.
Key Responsibilities:
•
Native app maintenance
Immediately take ownership of the existing Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android) apps. Resolve identified critical security issues: Android keystore rotation, static AES IV, cleartext traffic flag.
•
Launch support
Ensure both native apps are stable, tested, and fit for soft launch. Coordinate with the backend engineer on API integration and the QA engineer on test coverage.
•
Migration planning
Define the React Native migration strategy - phased approach, feature parity checklist, shared component library, testing plan.
•
React Native migration
Post-launch, lead the incremental migration of both apps to a single React Native codebase. Own the architecture: navigation, state management, native module decisions.
•
Security
Champion mobile security best practices: certificate pinning, secure storage, ProGuard obfuscation, root/jailbreak detection. Several known issues in the current codebase need addressing.
•
App store management
Own the App Store (iOS) and Google Play (Android) submission, review, and release processes.
•
Performance
Monitor and improve app performance: image loading, memory management, list rendering, network efficiency.
Must Have:
•
React Native
3+ years of production React Native experience. You have shipped apps on both iOS and Android from a single RN codebase.
•
iOS (Swift)
sufficient native iOS experience to read, maintain, and fix the existing Swift codebase through the transition period. You do not need to be a Swift specialist, but you cannot be blocked by it.
•
Android (Kotlin)
same as above — maintenance-level Kotlin competence. The Android app has specific critical security fixes that require native code changes.
•
Mobile security
you understand code signing, certificate management, secure storage, and the OWASP Mobile Top 10. Several critical vulnerabilities in our apps need fixing immediately.
•
App store processes
you have submitted to both App Store and Google Play and understand review guidelines, provisioning profiles, and release management.
•
State management
Redux, Zustand, or equivalent — you have an opinion and can defend it.
•
TypeScript
React Native with TypeScript is the target stack.
Nice to Have:
•
Expo
familiarity with the Expo ecosystem and when to use managed vs bare workflow.
•
Native modules
experience bridging native iOS/Android functionality into React Native.
•
UAE / Dubai apps
awareness of App Store / Play Store requirements for UAE-distributed apps.
•
Real estate or marketplace apps
experience with property listings, search, and similar data-rich interfaces.
•
Firebase
push notifications via FCM are core to the platform.
Interview Process:
•
Stage 1
Portfolio review — show us apps you have shipped. Walk us through one React Native codebase you are proud of.
•
Stage 2
Take-home paid task (2-3 hours) — build a small React Native screen against a mock API. We care about structure, not pixel perfection.
•
Stage 3
Final conversation with CEO — team fit, transition plan discussion, compensation.

title: Associate Web Developer
description:
We are looking for an Associate Web Developer to support our team during a significant engagement with a Riyadh-based client. This is a permanent, full-time position that is performed entirely through remote work. You will help build and maintain the digital tools that allow our clients to move from disorganized habits to clear, recorded management rhythms.
About the role
At Olive Tree Consulting, we believe that technology should make work easier to hold, not more complicated. This role exists to bridge the gap between our advisory work and the technical tools our clients need to stay organized. When we help a team fix their decision-making habits, they often need simple, reliable web interfaces where those decisions can be logged and tracked. You will work alongside our consultants to build these tools, ensuring they are functional and easy to use. This is an entry-level position where you will learn how to apply coding skills to solve practical management friction.
What you will do
Write clean and readable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build internal web tools and document repositories.
Update and maintain existing web environments used by our Riyadh-based client to ensure their records remain accessible.
Translate simple management processes, such as meeting rhythms or decision logs, into functional digital forms.
Troubleshoot and fix bugs in our internal tools to keep consulting projects moving without technical delays.
Collaborate with consultants to ensure the web interfaces we build match the plain-spoken and practical style of our firm.
Test new features for usability and performance across different browsers and devices.
Keep clear documentation for every tool you build so that clients can eventually manage these systems on their own.
Participate in remote team syncs to discuss project progress and share updates on technical tasks.
What we are looking for
A high degree of attention to detail and a preference for simple, working solutions over complex ones.
The ability to write clear, plain English in both your code comments and your communications with the team.
Curiosity about how businesses work and a desire to see how technology can solve structural management issues.
A reliable approach to remote work, including the ability to manage your own time and meet deadlines.
A patient mindset when it comes to troubleshooting and fixing small errors.
Comfort working in a team where the technical requirements are driven by practical consulting needs.
Willingness to learn new tools or languages as the needs of our client projects change.
Helpful background
Basic familiarity with modern web development frameworks or static site generators.
Experience with version control tools like Git.
Prior experience with personal coding projects or school assignments that involved building functional websites.
An understanding of how to make web pages accessible and responsive.
Interest in data organization and how to present information clearly on a screen.
Experience working in a collaborative environment, even if in a different field or through volunteer work.
What we offer
This is a fully remote position that provides the flexibility to work from a location that suits you. We provide a supportive environment where you can grow your technical skills while learning about the inner workings of corporate management. The position is paid, and the compensation is competitive for an entry-level role in today's market. You will have the chance to see your work used immediately by clients to solve real operational problems. We value steady, quiet work and provide the tools you need to stay connected with the team without the need for constant meetings.
About Olive Tree
Olive Tree Consulting Group is a focused advisory practice that helps leadership teams solve recurring management issues. We typically work on the space between strategy and daily execution. A team can have very capable people and still find that decisions keep reopening, priorities stall, or responsibility remains unclear. These are rarely personality problems: they are structural habits that have not kept up with the company's growth.
We favor practical changes over large-scale transformation programs. Our work involves looking at how decisions are made, how meetings are run, and how ownership is recorded. We prefer useful written notes and clear ownership over polished presentations and vague alignment. Good advisory work should make things plainer and leave the team with a rhythm they can continue on their own.
The firm is built on the principle that memory is not a management system. We help teams create the smallest possible written record to support their work so that important follow-up does not depend on who was in the room or who has the best memory. The goal is a quieter management pattern that makes the existing work easier to lead.

title: Mobile Developer
description:
Maak als Mobile Developer impact op de toekomst van verzekeren
Hoi, wij zijn InShared: een online verzekeraar die alles nét even anders doet. We maken met slimme technologie verzekeren simpel, snel en eerlijk. Ook hebben we de JaarBalans: Blijft er geld over in de schadepot? Dan geven we dat terug aan onze klanten.
Ooit zijn we gestart als de rebel in de verzekeringswereld. Nu staan we aan de vooravond van een internationale doorbraak. Vandaag nog met 300 mensen, straks misschien wel met 500. Om (internationaal) verder te groeien zoeken we ondernemende en energieke mensen die samen met ons verzekeringen willen blijven opschudden.
Wat we nodig hebben? Een
Mobile Developer
die onze mobiele apps naar een hoger niveau tilt en mee wil bouwen aan de digitale verzekeraar van de toekomst.
Wat ga je doen?
Als
Mobile Developer
ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, verbetering en innovatie van onze mobiele applicaties. Jij zorgt ervoor dat klanten altijd en overal eenvoudig hun verzekeringen kunnen beheren, schades kunnen melden en direct inzicht hebben in hun zaken.
Samen met product owners, UX-designers, backend developers en andere collega’s werk je in multidisciplinaire teams aan nieuwe functionaliteiten en een optimale gebruikerservaring. Je denkt niet alleen mee over de technische implementatie, maar ook over hoe we onze klanten nóg beter kunnen helpen.
Je bouwt schaalbare en betrouwbare oplossingen, bewaakt de kwaliteit van de codebase en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze mobiele architectuur. Daarbij krijg je veel ruimte om nieuwe ideeën aan te dragen en innovatieve technologieën te verkennen.
Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:
Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van onze mobiele apps voor iOS en Android
Ontwerpen en implementeren van nieuwe functionaliteiten
Verbeteren van prestaties, gebruiksvriendelijkheid en stabiliteit van de apps
Samenwerken met UX-, Product- en Backend-teams om de beste klantreis te realiseren
Schrijven van kwalitatieve, goed testbare en onderhoudbare code
Meedenken over architectuur, security en de technische roadmap
Monitoren, analyseren en oplossen van technische issues
Actief bijdragen aan code reviews en kennisdeling binnen het team
We all benefit. Dus jij ook
Naast de kans om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van verzekeren bieden wij je in de rol van Mobile Developer een salaris tussen € 65.000 en € 85.000 per jaar (inclusief vakantiegeld). Maar werken bij InShared heeft nog veel meer voordelen, we bieden ook:
31 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime dienstverband) en de mogelijkheid om extra verlof te ruilen
Een werkplek in onze kantoorvilla midden in de bossen
Een ingerichte thuiswerkplek
Maandelijkse internet- en thuiswerkvergoeding
Goed pensioen met een net zo goed partner- en nabestaandenpensioen
Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per kilometer of OV-vergoeding
Persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van € 750 per jaar - opsparen mag!
Een mini-sabbatical: eens per 5 jaar 5 dagen extra vrij
Welzijnsbudget van € 200 per jaar
En nog veel meer….
Wat breng je mee?
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met mobiele app-ontwikkeling
Ervaring met Flutter, React Native of native ontwikkeling voor iOS (Swift) en/of Android (Kotlin)]
Ervaring met REST API’s en integratie met backend services
Kennis van mobile architecture patterns en best practices
Ervaring met CI/CD-processen voor mobiele applicaties
Bekend met testautomatisering en kwaliteitsborging
Oog voor performance, security en gebruiksvriendelijkheid
Ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen
Een proactieve houding en de drive om continu te verbeteren
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en plezier in samenwerken
Mooi meegnomen:
Ervaring binnen een fintech, insurtech of andere digitale scale-up
Kennis van cloudplatformen zoals Azure
Ervaring met analytics, crash reporting en monitoringtools
Affiniteit met UX en customer-centric development
Sollicitatieproces:
Zie je het zitten?
We spreken je graag, natuurlijk met een kopje koffie of thee erbij. Eerst nog wat vragen? Stel ze gerust aan Steven via s.dusoswa@inshared.nl.

title: Mobile Developer
description:
Petal is a leading Canadian healthcare orchestration and medical billing company that is transforming healthcare systems by making them more agile, efficient, and resilient through advanced analytics, actionable insights, and innovative technology solutions.
Our commitment to fostering an exceptional workplace culture has earned us notable recognitions, including being named a
Great Place to Work
in both the technology and healthcare sectors. Join us in our mission to empower healthcare innovators and help improve healthcare differently.
What You Can Expect When Joining The Team
Reporting to the Software Development Manager - Mobile, you'll contribute to a team focused on delivering reliable, maintainable mobile experiences that support Petal's healthcare products across Canada. The mobile team builds and evolves
React Native applications
used in real clinical environments, and your work will be felt by healthcare professionals every day.
You'll collaborate with product managers, designers, and fellow developers to ship high-quality mobile features, participate in technical design conversations, and help keep the codebase consistent, well-tested, and secure. This is a hands-on role with genuine impact at the feature level, not just implementation tasks assigned from above.
You're also expected to bring a thoughtful approach to
AI-assisted development
. That means using tools like Copilot or similar to move faster and write better code, while taking real ownership of what gets reviewed and merged.
Your Day To Day, You Will
Build and ship React Native features across iOS and Android, working closely with product managers and designers to deliver polished, production-ready experiences.
Participate in technical design discussions, applying your understanding of the app architecture to propose sound, maintainable solutions at the feature level.
Write well-tested code and take part in code reviews with a focus on correctness, clarity, and security, not just checking boxes.
Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate implementation, documentation, and troubleshooting, then critically evaluate the output before it lands in the codebase.
Identify and help resolve performance issues, crashes, and reliability gaps in production mobile applications.
Break down moderately complex problems into clear tasks, estimate timelines with your team's input, and surface blockers before they become escalations.
Work within and contribute to the mobile CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Fastlane), understanding how builds, tests, and releases come together end to end.
Follow shared component and coding standards that keep the codebase consistent across teams and apps, and contribute improvements where you see them.
Adapt quickly to new tools, libraries, and techniques as the mobile ecosystem evolves, seeking guidance to stay aligned with team practices.
Share knowledge openly, give constructive feedback in reviews and conversations, and support teammates when capacity allows.
Your profile
Hands-on experience building mobile applications with React Native, with a track record of shipping features to production on iOS and Android.
Strong TypeScript skills and a disciplined approach to type safety and code quality.
Solid understanding of iOS and Android platform fundamentals and their constraints. You know why things behave differently across platforms and how to handle it.
Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, and a genuine commitment to reliability over speed for its own sake.
Comfortable working within CI/CD pipelines and understanding how mobile releases reach production.
Clear, proactive communicator who keeps teammates informed, flags blockers early, and contributes to a culture of open collaboration.
Nice-to-have
Native development experience (Swift or Kotlin) for bridging or platform-specific integrations.
Familiarity with shared component libraries or design systems.
Experience in a monorepo environment (Nx, Turborepo, or similar).
Prior exposure to app performance monitoring or crash reporting tools.
We recognize that experience comes in many forms. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply.
Why joining us
Your code runs in real clinical environments. Healthcare professionals across Canada use our mobile apps every day, and reliability genuinely matters.
The mobile team is investing in AI-enhanced development practices, and you'll help shape how those tools get adopted responsibly as they mature.
This role gives you real input into feature-level design decisions, not just a queue of implementation tickets.
Petal's mobile platform is growing, and there's real room to take on more responsibility as both the product and the team scale.
Our Benefits
4 to 6 weeks of paid vacation per year;
5 paid personal days per year ;
A group RRSP / DPSP plan with employer contribution;
A complete group insurance plan, from day 1;
An annual wellness allowance;
Access to the Lumino Health™ telehealth application;
Recurring remote/hybrid work allowance; In our opinion, a company cannot claim to be modern, innovative and have the well-being of their team at heart, without attempting to integrate remote working to the level that their business model allows them to.
Petal is an active participant in the equal opportunity employment program, and members of the following target groups are encouraged to apply: women, people with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. If you are a person with a disability, assistance with the screening and selection process is available on request.

title: Software Engineer, Mobile
description:
🏛️ About GovWell
We the people — and the taxpayers — deserve good government. Yet today, interacting with government services is often frustrating and inefficient. GovWell is building the AI operating system transforming how governments serve communities, starting with local agencies.
GovWell replaces legacy software for municipalities and counties, empowering public servants to radically streamline public services and cut internal processing time for permits and licenses by up to 95%.
Founded in 2023, GovWell powers 5,000+ mission-critical processes for agencies in 35+ states serving millions of residents. The company has raised $35M in funding from Insight Partners, Work-Bench, and Bienville Capital, and the team works in person at GovWell HQ in New York City. Read more about our founding story in TechCrunch.
🌟 Role Overview
Millions of Americans don't have reliable access to a laptop or desktop — for a lot of the country, a phone is the only way they'll ever interact with government services. GovWell's mobile presence is still early: real, in the hands of real users, but small enough that most of what it becomes is still being figured out.
GovWell is hiring a
Mobile Engineer
to join
Zach
, who's been building GovWell's mobile foundation, and help take it from early to real scale. You'll work on both sides of mobile at GovWell: giving government staff and field workers a faster, more reliable way to do their jobs, and giving residents a simple, direct way to interact with their local government from their phone.
This role reports directly to our CTO and Co-Founder, Ben Cohen.
We have a hybrid work culture that combines regular in-person collaboration at our New York City office (3+ days per week) with flexibility to work remotely.
☀️ Why GovWell?
A mission that matters: Building AI-powered products to fix outdated government systems isn’t just a technical challenge—it’s a historic opportunity to improve our foundational relationship with government and ensure trillions of tax dollars result in high quality services. WATCH: Mission & Vision with CEO & Co-Founder Troy LeCaire
Real-world impact: GovWell’s product is the system of record for government services that affect millions of Americans. From streamlining permitting for small businesses to accelerating affordable housing development, your work will make an immediate difference.
Join a startup in hyper-growth: We’ve found product-market fit and are scaling the business very quickly (4X ARR growth in the last year). As an early team member, you’ll learn what it takes to build a successful startup. You’ll work closely with the founders while enjoying exceptional autonomy and ownership over your work.
💻 What You’ll Do
Build the field experience GovWell staff actually want to use — fast, reliable, and built for real conditions, not a scaled-down version of the web product.
Make sure the work doesn't stop just because the signal does. Field staff should never lose progress or have to re-do something because they lost connectivity.
Put permitting and licensing directly in residents' hands — simple enough that checking a permit status or submitting an application feels as easy as anything else on their phone.
Help define what native mobile craft looks like at GovWell — this is a young product, and the standard you set now is the standard the product grows into.
Shape what's next as mobile matures: new workflows, new capabilities, and how the staff and citizen experiences evolve relative to each other.
🧠
Who you are
Real experience shipping production mobile apps on iOS and/or Android.
Comfortable owning ambiguous, early-stage decisions on a product that's growing quickly
You think about speed and friction obsessively — tap counts, load times, and the assumption your user might be standing outside, one-handed, in a hurry.
Product instincts: you can help decide what to build next and why, not just execute a fully-specified ticket.
You align closely with our Core Values.
🖥️
Our tech stack
Native iOS (Swift, SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose)
React, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, RedwoodJS, AWS (core platform, for API/backend context)
OpenAI API
💸 Compensation And Benefits
Compensation within the posted salary band will be commensurate with experience. All offers will include:
Competitive base salary.
Equity / stock options.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) program.
Flexible PTO.
➡️ Click here to meet the engineering team
Below: a picture of the entire GovWell team celebrating our Series A with a boat cruise on the Hudson!
Compensation Range: $195K - $260K

description:
We get up every day, roll up our sleeves and build a better world -- together. At Ford, we’re all a part of something bigger than ourselves. Are you ready to change the way the world moves?

plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are.

Bring UI to Life: Utilize Rive to create state-driven, interactive vector animations that respond in real-time to voice triggers, system states, and user emotions.
Modern Architecture: Maintain a clean, scalable codebase using MVVM (Model-View-View Model) or MVI patterns to handle complex voice-interaction states.
Performance Optimization: Ensure the UI is "automotive grade" — meaning it must be ultra-responsive, stable, and performant under the unique constraints of vehicle hardware.
Collaborate: Work closely with VUI (Voice User Interface) designers, AI engineers, and Product Managers to bridge the gap between spoken word and visual feedback.
Innovation: Stay at the forefront of Android development, prototyping new ways for drivers to interact with AI without compromising safety.
You'll have...
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science. (Successful candidates will be required to provide proof of degree completion for the highest level of education attained. If the degree was obtained from a school outside of Canada, an Education Credential Assessment report showing Canadian equivalency is also required).
Experience
Minimum 4 years of professional Android development experience with a deep understanding of the Android SDK and Kotlin.
Minimum 2 years experience with Jetpack Compose. You should be comfortable building complex layouts, custom modifiers, and high-performance components.
Mastery of MVVM and a solid understanding of Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection (Hilt/Dagger), and Coroutines/Flow for asynchronous state management.
Experience consuming RESTful APIs and handling real-time data streams (WebSockets or WebRTC) which power the voice assistant's logic.
Even better, you may have...
Interactive Motion: Proven experience integrating Rive (or similar state-machine-based animation tools like Lottie) into production applications.
Familiarity with Agile development processes.
Multi-process, multi-tasking or multi-threaded based applications.
Excellent communication skills.

title: Senior TouchDesigner Developer
description:
Job Title:
TouchDesigner Developer / Creative Technologist
Location
: Onsite/ Hybrid (Amman, Jordan)
Employment Type
: Full-Time
Experience Level
: 5+ Years Professional Experience
About the Role
We are looking for a specialized and highly experienced Senior TouchDesigner Developer with 5+ years of industry experience to architect, build, and deploy real-time interactive installations, projection-mapped environments, and dynamic visual software from scratch. At our studio, we blend art, software engineering, and hardware to make memorable, large-scale spatial experiences.
In this role, you will own the technical and visual execution of our interactive installations. You will build clean, scalable TouchDesigner networks, write custom Python extensions, develop GLSL shaders, and integrate real-time sensors and multi-display outputs for live client projects and permanent installations.
What You Will Do
Network Architecture & Development
: Design, build, and maintain clean, modular, and optimized TouchDesigner projects, components (COMPs), and custom Python extensions.
Real-Time Visuals & Shaders
: Create high-fidelity generative graphics, real-time visual feedback loops, and bespoke GLSL shaders (compute shaders, raymarching, or SDFs) tailored to interactive environments.
Projection & Multi-Screen Systems
: Configure complex multi-display routing, edge blending, LED wall outputs, and projection mapping across custom architectural surfaces.
Hardware & Sensor Integration
: Connect TouchDesigner with external hardware, including depth cameras, LiDAR, touch walls, interactive floor sensors, and lighting systems via OSC, UDP, DMX, or custom APIs.
Optimization & Troubleshooting
: Profile and debug node networks, CPU/GPU bottlenecks, and frame-rate drops to ensure 24/7 rock-solid stability for permanent installations and live setups.
What We Are Looking For
5+ Years Professional Experience
: At least 5 years of commercial, industry-level experience building and shipping large-scale interactive projects, exhibitions, or live installations using TouchDesigner (hobbyist work alone does not qualify).
Deep TouchDesigner & Python Mastery
: Advanced proficiency in TouchDesigner’s operator families (TOPs, CHOPs, SOPs, DATs, COMPs), object-oriented Python scripting, and custom component design.
Hardware / Sensor Literacy:
Proven track record of integrating interactive physical sensors, tracking cameras, and multi-channel audio/visual hardware into real-time software.
GLSL & Shader Knowledge
: Solid understanding of real-time rendering pipelines and writing or modifying GLSL shaders.
Self-Directed Engineering Mindset
: A strong focus on structured, clean, and reusable programming practices so tools and systems can be adapted for future studio projects.
Bonus Points (Nice to Have)
Experience with companion real-time software and media servers (e.g., MadMapper, Resolume, Notch, or Unreal Engine).
Experience working with C# or C++ for custom tool and DLL development.
Experience integrating modern AI APIs or LLMs into real-time interactive installations.
How to Apply
Please apply directly through LinkedIn by clicking Apply.
Important Note:
Make sure your resume or LinkedIn profile includes a direct link to your online portfolio, GitHub repository, or video showreel demonstrating real-world TouchDesigner installations and interactive systems! (
Applications without visual examples of previous interactive work will not be reviewed.
)

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.
This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.
What Will You Build
Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.
Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.
Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.
Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.
Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

The Bar

title: Android Engineer
description:
About Us
At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging.
We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building and scaling companies, and the other a leader in retail data and shopper analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses.
The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the engineering culture, and what algo1 becomes.
The Role
You will report to our Head of Android, Kiril, and work closely with product, design, backend and edge AI specialists to build the consumer-facing product through which millions of shoppers could experience algo1.
This is native Kotlin development on our own application, running on a known device inside live grocery stores. That creates a distinctive set of engineering challenges around performance, reliability, lifecycle management and resilience in a demanding physical environment.
We are AI-native in how we build. Every engineer has access to frontier coding tools and our own development harness. We expect you to use them thoughtfully to move faster and tackle more ambitious work, while remaining fully accountable for the quality of what reaches shoppers.
What You’ll Own
Shopper-facing features end to end. Take substantial Android features from the first product conversation through implementation, release and iteration in stores.
On-device intelligence. Connect our edge AI capabilities to the shopper experience, turning machine-learning outputs into interactions that feel genuinely useful.

title: Android Developer
description:
Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface.
Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range.
This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own well-scoped features end to end and deliver them reliably, working closely with our senior Android engineer who reviews the high-stakes work and helps you grow into the harder problems. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, and you ship software that runs on real machines in real locations.
This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu's Software & Intelligence Engineering team.
What You'll Build & Own
On-device Android software:
Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end.
Fleet-ready releases:
Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe.
Hardware & firmware integration:
Work with embedded and firmware engineers to make on-device behaviour seamless — serial communication, device state, real-world edge cases.
Mobile contribution:
Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it.
AI-native development:
Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship.
What You Bring
Solid Android engineering experience: 3-5 years building and shipping Android software in Kotlin. You know the platform well beyond tutorials.
Curiosity for Android outside the phone: on-device, kiosk, embedded-adjacent, or AOSP experience is a strong plus — genuine interest and solid fundamentals get you there too.
You handle well-scoped work independently: you plan it, communicate progress and risks, and deliver end to end — and you know when to pull in a senior for the high-risk calls.
AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. If your last six months of work doesn't look meaningfully different because of AI, this isn't your role.
✨ Why join us?
You'll be right at the center of everything, with clear responsibilities and the freedom to own them. You'll work closely with our Service Engineers, logistics partners, and Client Support team in an informal, direct, and collaborative environment. And best of all? No two days are the same.
💰 A salary between 66-89k yearly (incl. 8% holiday allowance)
📈 Equity through our Aquablu for All plan: it's not just about shares, it's about shared success.
🏋️ Urban Sports Club Membership
🌱 Healthy (heavily discounted) lunches
🎯 Purpose with Impact: shape how the world hydrates while wiping out single-use plastics.
📋 Scale-up pace means fresh challenges (and new skills) every quarter.
🤝 Join an ambitious, bold, and fun crew that's always got your back.
🌱 Company-sponsored gym membership keeps mind and body in sync.
💰 Pension plan with Zwitserleven (50/50 split) so you grow while your savings do, too.
🎵 What kind of vibe can you expect at our office? Check out our very own Spotify playlist "Akwablues"
🎬 Curious about our story & culture? Check our documentaries on Youtube!

Wealthfront’s culture centers around continuous learning, innovation, and quality-driven software development. With high quality software as our ultimate engineering objective, our key tactic is automation:

Wealthfront software automates the financial services we provide to our clients, and within these services we automate the collection of data that we learn from on our way to making our services even better.

Wealthfront engineers function as builder/operators, with dual responsibility for building the system and operating it in production. Any toil that this brings about is automated away by engineers. Wealthfront engineers automate our development processes. For example, Wealthfront engineers automate all of our testing. Manual testing is not part of the software development lifecycle at Wealthfront.

Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.
Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.
Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.
Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.
What We're Looking For
Strong native iOS experience using Swift.
Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.
Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.
Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.
Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.
The Bar
We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.
This Role Is Not For
Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.
Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.
People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.
Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.
People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.
Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in
Australia
. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in
Australia
.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
Online assessment or practical task
Role-specific interview
CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: iOS Engineer, Customer Growth
description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.
Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.
About The Growth Team
The
Customer Acquisition, Growth, and Engagement
team (CAGE) is focused on streamlining and innovating around the new and returning user experience for Thumbtack. By adding value for users and meeting their needs, we can activate them as first time customers and convince them to return to Thumbtack to help solve future problems by ensuring their experience was a good one.
We accomplish this by focusing both on getting the fundamentals right around core experiences like login and auth, as well as by building new features that allow us to better understand user needs early in their journey to get them to the right place.
The challenge
Many of the sorts of changes we’re making are unproven, and as a data driven company, we prefer to run experiments that vet our hypotheses. As an engineer, balancing places we can be scrappy to test ideas quickly vs places we need to take more care to exercise engineering rigor and build things the right way is important. Given we have cross functional teams, if you like looking at user problems from a product or design perspective, you’ll be a great fit for this.
What You’ll Do
Drive iOS feature projects to completion, focusing on the business and customer impact of those projects.
Break down large projects into concrete deliverables and milestones that make it easy to track progress.
Work closely with back-end engineers, product managers, designers, data analysts, and other teams to gather feedback, prioritize projects, and deliver solutions.
Communicate project status to stakeholders, proactively raising potential blockers and other risks.
Explore new frameworks and processes while also being able to discuss when (or when not) to use them.
Participate in a culture that values thoughtful code reviews and frequent deployments.
In order to be successful, you must bring
Passionate iOS engineer with experience building, testing, releasing, and maintaining apps written in Swift or Objective-C.
Proven track record of shipping consumer-facing apps that users love on the App Store.
Cross-functional collaboration and communication. We’re moving quickly, so it’s important for our engineers to communicate their status regularly, proactively bring up potential blockers and risks, and keep our cross-functional partners in the loop.

title: Software Engineer 2 - iOS Engineering
description:
Who You'll Work With
The Activity Apps team builds and operates Nike Run Club (NRC) and Nike Training Club (NTC) - the mobile experiences that move millions of Nike athletes through runs, workouts, training plans, and guided coaching every day. As a Software Engineer 2 on iOS, you'll be a growing IC on a feature squad, partnering daily with senior iOS engineers, Android peers, backend engineers, Product, Design, and QA. This role reports to an Engineering Manager for Activity Apps and works alongside Principal and Lead engineers who will invest in your growth.
Who We Are Looking For
Nike is seeking a Software Engineer 2 on iOS who has shipped in a real consumer app, is comfortable in modern iOS, and is ready to grow into more complex ownership. You'll take on well-scoped features and pieces of larger initiatives, write clean and testable Swift, and lean into the mentorship the team offers. The ideal candidate cares about craft, moves fast without cutting corners, and is curious about how the app actually behaves in an athlete's hand.
What You Bring
2+ years of professional iOS development experience shipping consumer-facing apps
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; will accept any suitable combination of education, experience and training
Proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (and comfort with UIKit where it still lives); working knowledge of modern concurrency (async/await, Combine)
Understanding of iOS architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, Composable/TCA) and how features are structured in a modularized codebase (SPM, frameworks)
Familiarity with the iOS frameworks activity apps rely on - Core Location, Core Motion, background modes, AVFoundation / audio, push - and willingness to go deep in the areas you own
Comfort consuming REST/GraphQL APIs and handling offline, low-bandwidth, and error states gracefully
Experience writing unit and UI tests (XCTest, snapshot testing, XCUITest)
Familiarity with Xcode, Fastlane, CI/CD, and the App Store release process
Strong debugging habits and an interest in growing them - Instruments profiling, memory analysis, crash triage
Collaborative mindset; clear communicator in code review, design discussion, and written docs
Experience with Spec Driven Development leveraging LLM coding agents and autonomous build and review loops
What You'll Work On
You'll build features in NRC or NTC on iOS alongside more senior engineers who will help you take on progressively more complex work. Your code will run in the hands of millions of athletes.
Implement features in the NRC or NTC iOS app - from spec through shipped release with guidance from senior engineers on the squad
Own the iOS side of well-scoped feature work and contribute pieces of larger, cross-platform initiatives
Write clean, testable, idiomatic Swift and uphold the team's quality bar in code review
Contribute to the workout session stack on iOS and adjacent surfaces (sensors, background execution, storage, upload) as you build depth in this area
Instrument features for observability and experimentation; learn from production behavior and iterate
Participate in on-call rotation for app stability; help triage crashes and consumer-reported issues on iOS
Learn and adopt iOS best practices and platform updates that improve the athlete experience
Adopt AI-native development practices on the iOS team - internal AI tooling, code assistance, evaluation harnesses - and share what's working
Position Location & Schedule
This position is based at our incredibly beautiful worldwide campus headquarters location in Beaverton, Oregon. You'll work a "4/1 hybrid" schedule - Mondays - Thursdays are in the office and it's optional if you'd like to work Fridays from the Nike campus office or your home office.
We offer a number of accommodations to complete our interview process including screen readers, sign language interpreters, accessible and single location for in-person interviews, closed captioning, and other reasonable modifications as needed. If you discover, as you navigate our application process, that you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please complete the Candidate Accommodation Request Form.

title: iOS Developer
description:
Build the next generation of digital experiences
At Alphero, we're creating and composing the intelligent digital experiences of the future.
For more than 14 years we've partnered with organisations across New Zealand, Australia and the United States to design and deliver digital products that improve how people live, work and play. Chances are you've already used apps and websites we've helped create.
Today we're evolving again. Alongside designing and building exceptional digital products, we're exploring how AI, intelligent services and composable technologies are changing what's possible. Our teams are helping clients navigate that future while continuing to deliver beautifully crafted, accessible and secure digital experiences today.
We're looking for an experienced iOS Developer who enjoys solving complex problems, cares about quality, and wants to be part of shaping where mobile development goes next.
The role
As an iOS Developer at Alphero you'll work across the full product lifecycle, from early technical thinking and architecture through to delivery, release and ongoing evolution.
Agency life means variety. You might be joining an established product, helping shape a brand new mobile experience, contributing to discovery work with a client, or collaborating with our wider team to solve a tricky technical challenge. Every project is different.
You'll work closely with designers, strategists, QA specialists and other developers to build products that are intuitive, reliable and enjoyable to use. We believe the best ideas come from collaboration, so while we offer flexible hybrid working, we're very much an in-person team.
What you'll be doing
Building outstanding iOS applications - Develop high-quality native iOS applications using modern Swift, contributing to architecture, implementation, performance and maintainability across the products you work on.
Delivering beautifully crafted customer experiences - Work alongside designers and testers to create experiences that feel polished, accessible and genuinely enjoyable to use.
Working with modern engineering practices - Use contemporary tooling, automation and AI-assisted development to help you move faster while maintaining quality. We see AI as another engineering tool, one that helps developers spend more time solving interesting problems and less time writing repetitive code. Thoughtful engineering judgement, review and craftsmanship still matter.
Contributing to our practice - Share ideas, mentor others where appropriate, stay current with the Apple ecosystem, and help us continually improve the way we build software.
Requirements
You'll probably have around 4-8+ years of professional iOS development experience and be comfortable working across the different layers of a modern mobile application.
You'll have extensive experience with:
Swift and modern iOS development practices
UIKit and/or SwiftUI
API integration and networking
Authentication and secure data handling
Local persistence
Performance optimisation and debugging
Writing clean, maintainable and well-structured code
AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or similar
Building applications with security, privacy and accessibility in mind
It would also be great if you've worked with some of the following:
CI/CD pipelines and automated testing
App Store release processes
Cloud-connected platforms and API development (particularly AWS-based services)
Mobile analytics and monitoring
Kotlin Multiplatform or other shared-code approaches
Most importantly, we're looking for someone who's curious. Technology is changing quickly and we're investing heavily in understanding how AI and emerging technologies will shape the next generation of digital experiences. We want developers who are excited to learn, experiment and help define what good engineering looks like in that future.
This is a New Zealand-based role working from one of our offices in Wellington or Auckland.
Benefits
You'll join a team that genuinely cares about building great products and helping each other improve. Our developers work alongside experienced designers, strategists and testers in cross-functional teams, giving you the opportunity to influence products well beyond the code you write.
Our values of Inventive, Emotive and Brave aren't just words on a wall. They show up in the way we work with clients, the way we support one another and the way we're investing in what's next.
If you're looking for somewhere you can build exceptional mobile experiences today while helping shape the future of digital tomorrow, we'd love to hear from you.
This is a New Zealand-based role working from one of our offices in Wellington or Auckland.

title: iOS Engineer
description:
*This role supports US-based remote work, or Palo Alto, CA based hybrid in-office.
We’re looking for iOS Engineers to join our team. As part of a cross-functional scrum team you will design and develop new investment account and cash account features within our iOS app. In addition to development on the app itself, you will write automated tests and integrate with our in-house design systems and our backend API. Come help our clients and prospective clients build wealth on their own terms!
About Wealthfront Engineering
Wealthfront’s culture centers around continuous learning, innovation, and quality-driven software development. With high quality software as our ultimate engineering objective, our key tactic is automation:
•
Wealthfront software automates the financial services we provide to our clients, and within these services we automate the collection of data that we learn from on our way to making our services even better.
•
Wealthfront engineers function as builder/operators, with dual responsibility for building the system and operating it in production. Any toil that this brings about is automated away by engineers. This investment in automation is expected, and the prioritization of it is always built into our planning and execution.
•
Wealthfront engineers automate our development processes. For example, Wealthfront engineers automate all of our testing. Manual testing is not part of the software development lifecycle at Wealthfront.
•
Wealthfront engineers automate observability in case of failure. If something is up, our systems inform engineers appropriately. If our systems are quiet, they are healthy.
If you are drawn to being an engineer within such an environment, and having outsized impact as an engineer at a magnitude that is only available within a company achieving greatness at our size (~350 employees, half in engineering), then we want to hear from you!
As a core member of the team, you will:
Build a premier native iOS application
Take ownership of large, complex projects from ideation through execution and delivery.
Collaborate with product, design, and engineering leadership to shape the roadmap and deliver a seamless and delightful user experience.
Work with frontend and backend engineers to design, build and test reusable REST APIs
Design and build high-quality infrastructure; making the right tradeoffs for risk and long-term maintainability
Get an opportunity to work with leadership to define the team's priorities and initiatives
Work independently, use available resources to get unblocked, and complete tasks on schedule by exercising strong judgment and problem-solving skills
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers
Ensure our iOS app and iOS CI systems operate smoothly in production by triaging and resolving operational issues as part of a team of on-call engineers
This role could be a fit if you have:
2 - 6 years of professional iOS development experience
Deep expertise with Swift and iOS frameworks - knowledge of Objective-C is a plus but not required
Experience creating complex and performant user interfaces with UIKit and/or SwiftUI
Experience writing unit tests and testable code
A track record of delivering high-quality, testable, and maintainable code.
Excellent problem solving, critical thinking and communication skills
BS or MS in computer science, related field, or equivalent professional experience
Once you join, Wealthfront will:
Pair you with a mentor who will guide you through our structured onboarding program
Involve you in cross-functional planning and technical strategy discussions.
Support your professional development by providing feedback during weekly 1:1s and our semi-annual reviews
Empower you with autonomy and ownership over impactful initiatives that shape the future of our iOS platform.
Estimated annual salary range: $150,000 - $189,000 plus equity and a discretionary bonus.
Benefits include medical, vision, dental, 401K plan, generous time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursements, professional development, employee investing discount, and more!
About Wealthfront
Here at Wealthfront, our mission is to create a financial system that favors people, not institutions. We do this by leveraging technology to build powerful, low-cost, and easy-to-use financial products that help modern investors grow and manage their money.
We started with the ambition to transform the investment advisory business. By automating strategies typically reserved for the wealthy, we unlocked access to high quality investment advice for a digitally-native generation that was underserved by traditional institutions. Since then, we've expanded to a full suite of products designed to help our clients turn their savings into long-term wealth, including:
• A Cash Account that, through our partner banks, offers one of the highest annual percentage yields on uninvested cash in the industry, while providing instant and secure access to your money with no account fees and a full suite of checking features.
• A zero-commission Stock Investing Account with 50+ handpicked collections that help DIY investors discover new companies and make smarter investing decisions.
• Multiple automated investing portfolios designed to unlock tax savings through sophisticated strategies like fixed income, tax-loss harvesting, and direct indexing—which we offer at industry-leading low costs and accessible minimums.
Our award-winning products have attracted over 1 million clients who trust us with more than $90 billion of their hard earned savings—and we're far from done. If you’re inspired to help us reshape the financial industry as we create our next chapter, let’s talk!
For more information please visit
www.wealthfront.com
.We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Please review our
candidate privacy notice
.

title: Software Engineer (iOS)
description:
You ll have visibility into, and influence over, all parts of the technology stack, and enjoy a high degree of autonomy in your work.
You ll have a clear view of the product roadmap, the business long-term vision, and the opportunity to constructively contribute to both.
You ll interact with product management and design, and be able to influence what solutions are chosen to meet customer needs.
You ll contribute to the planning, design, development, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of significant portions of the software that supports the chosen solutions.
You ll have the chance to provide and receive feedback from your peers, and get coaching from more experienced engineers both within the team and the broader organization.
You Ll Use Modern Tooling Throughout, Whether That s Something Currently Part Of Our Stack, Or Something New That You Assess Needs To Be Added To Reliably Deliver The Desired User Experience. A Snapshot Of What s Currently In-use
Swift (for new development) and Objective-C
SwiftUI, Core Data, ReactiveSwift, and Combine
CI/CD: Github, CircleCI, and Fastlane
You ll enjoy the flexibility, tempo, and ownership of being part of a startup, and the job security of being employed by one of Canada s most valuable companies.
You ll work with an extremely committed team of colleagues who re constantly challenging each other, compassionately, and in a transparent, structured way, to get to the next level in our careers.
The Expectations
You ll be responsible for leading the design and delivery of a significant portion of the software that supports the business, and for monitoring and maintaining that software in production.

You re curious, and naturally invest energy into learning new technologies, techniques, and interpersonal skills that, you feel, help improve your own productivity and happiness, and the productivity and happiness of those around you. title: Software Developer — iOS (Canada)
description:
Communication belongs to everyone. TextNow is one of the largest providers of free phone service in North America, connecting tens of millions of people who would otherwise be priced out of staying in touch. We pair a free, ad-supported tier with paid plans and a growing set of intelligent features — and we run it on infrastructure we own and operate. We move fast, we measure what we ship, and we treat AI as a core part of how we build, not a side experiment.
What You'll Do
As a Software Developer on iOS, you'll own the systems, architecture, and tooling behind apps used by millions — operating strategically across mobile, backend, and data, and diving into the lowest-level details when the problem demands it. This is an AI-first role: using AI is not optional, it's the expectation. We anticipate the majority of the code you ship will be AI-generated, with you as the architect, reviewer, and final authority on quality, correctness, and design. You'll have access to the latest and greatest AI development tools, and you'll help build our AI harness — the agents, workflows, evaluations, and guardrails the rest of engineering relies on. We hire across multiple levels (intermediate, senior, staff+) and align title and scope to demonstrated impact, not years on a résumé.
Design, develop, and sustain high-performance iOS applications in Swift, SwiftUI, and Objective-C, with AI tooling embedded throughout your workflow.
Own the full lifecycle of your systems: feature ideation, API design, instrumentation, CI/CD deployment, live-traffic monitoring, unit/UI/e2e testing, telemetry and data analysis, A/B experiment design, and continuous iteration.
Lead architectural modernization — decompose monoliths, build shared libraries and frameworks, improve modularization, and enable reuse across iOS, Android, and Web.
Evaluate and adopt new Apple platform capabilities (OS releases, device types, form factors, architectures) and lead their rollout.
Build and extend our internal AI harness — agents, automation frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and guardrails — so the whole team ships faster and safer; continuously evolve how you use AI and push the org's standards for what "good" looks like.
Define observability standards, telemetry pipelines, and fault-tolerance strategies for production-grade mobile systems.
Partner closely with product, design, backend, and data; drive technical discussions, mentor developers, and influence strategic direction across mobile.
Who You Are
We're raising the bar. This role is not a fit for developers early in building production systems, and our screen reflects that. Strong candidates will clear most of the following:
Deep iOS expertise. Production mastery of Swift, SwiftUI, and modern concurrency (async/await, actors), plus comfort in legacy Objective-C. You've shipped and operated consumer iOS apps at meaningful scale.
Architect-level judgment. A proven track record designing modular, maintainable systems that balance speed and reliability — and the ability to defend those trade-offs.
Production-readiness as a default. You architect for observability and reliability: instrumentation, SLOs/SLIs, fault tolerance, runbooks, incident triage, scalable telemetry pipelines, and live production diagnostics for mobile clients.
Genuine AI fluency. You already use AI across your development workflow and can speak specifically about where it helps, where it fails, and how you've improved on its output. You're excited to generate most of your code with AI and to own the quality bar on top of it.
Demonstrated technical leadership. You've influenced roadmaps, contributed to multi-team initiatives, mentored or led developers, driven process and culture improvements, and worked directly with senior engineering and product leadership.
Performance and systems depth. Strong background in performance optimization, observability, and system-level debugging.
Who Thrives At TextNow
The strongest engineers we've hired share a set of traits. We screen for them directly, so come ready with specific examples:
Initiative. You uncover problems and opportunities nobody asked you to solve, and you act on them.
Customer obsession. Direct user observation and customer behavior change how you build — not just what the spec says.
Curiosity that compounds. You go deep on technical topics on your own, and that curiosity turns into real process and product improvements.
Comfort with ambiguity. You move forward decisively when information is missing, and you make sound calls when there's no obvious right answer.
Adaptive prioritization. When priorities shift midstream, you rebalance feature work against reliability, operational, and customer-impact concerns without losing the plot.
Productive disagreement. When you disagree with an approach, you make the case directly and constructively, and you know how to disagree-and-commit.
Scope-expanding ownership. You improve systems, workflows, and experiences beyond the original assignment.
Minimum Qualifications

description:

Trove is looking for an
iOS Engineer
to join our early-stage team. As we prepare to launch our first product we need talented developers with bold ideas who can help bring the team’s vision to life.
You’ll work closely with the founders, product, design, and backend engineering to shape the app from its earliest foundations. Your contributions will meaningfully influence the direction of the product, the engineering culture, and the standards we set as we grow.
We’re looking for someone who thrives in the energy of a founding team where priorities evolve, constraints are real, and momentum matters. You should be excited to roll up your sleeves, make thoughtful architectural decisions with incomplete information, and lay down systems that can support rapid product evolution without compromising the user experience.
The right person has strong empathy for the end user and appreciates clean, functional design. You should care about craft, performance, and the details that make an experience feel effortless. This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving environment where ideas turn into shipped features quickly, and where you’ll help determine not just how things are built, but how they function and feel.
On any given week, you might:
Architect core product systems in that will scale long term
Design and implement high-fidelity, animation-heavy user experiences
Partner with Product and Design to turn ambiguous ideas into clean, intuitive flows
Ship experiments quickly, then iterate and expand on what works
Improve app performance, responsiveness, and reliability at scale
Implement networking layers and real-time updates that power live marketplace activity
Make thoughtful tradeoffs between speed and maintainability
Raise the bar on code quality, architecture, and engineering culture
You have experience and success in these areas:
Strong proficiency in Swift (SwiftUI and/or UIKit)
Shipping and scaling a highly interactive consumer app
Building complex, stateful interfaces that feel simple
Owning features end-to-end, from design through launch
Collaborating closely with founders, designers, and backend engineers
Moving forward with incomplete information and operating despite ambiguity
Building for marketplace, fintech, gaming, or social apps
What success looks like:
Trove feels like a top-tier, category-defining iOS app
Complex actions like buying, opening, selling, and redeeming feel simple and intuitive
The app is fast, stable, and scales cleanly
Our architecture supports rapid iteration without accumulating technical debt
Engineering quality becomes a visible differentiator for the company
The experience feels polished and intuitive, with a level of design quality users recognize and trust
Who shouldn’t apply:
Anyone looking to just execute tickets
Anyone who prefers heavy process over momentum
Anyone who hasn’t worked on a consumer product before
Anyone uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapid iteration
Anyone who doesn’t care about the feel of the product
About us:
We’re building a new kind of collectibles company from the ground up. Trove lets you buy and open packs digitally, then choose to keep, sell, or physically redeem cards. We’re just getting started but our team is led by proven entrepreneurs with multiple exits and has raised capital from top tier investors.
We know that putting together a talented, passionate group of people is the most important part of building a business. Our bar is high and our results are exceptional. This is an environment where you’ll feel challenged, grow beyond what you’ve done before, and visibly see how your work impacts the business. Our job is to give you what you need and get out of your way.
Beyond that, we offer highly competitive comp, free health insurance, flexible time off, and meaningful equity so you’ll share in the company’s success. The team is headquartered in NYC and hiring for flexible in-person work.

title: iOS App Development Engineer
description:
The Opportunity
Adobe's Nextcam team is seeking a Software Development Engineer with training and/or experience in building smartphone apps for iOS, to join our team in San Jose, California. We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience developing, optimizing, and shipping camera, photography, graphics, or image processing apps.
About Our Team And Project Indigo
Nextcam is a relatively new team, led by VP and Fellow Marc Levoy. We’re part of the larger org responsible for Photoshop and Lightroom, but we operate like a startup inside that org – with significant agility and autonomy. As part of our portfolio, we recently launched Project Indigo, an experimental camera app for iPhone that combines computational photography and AI, and that deliberately explores the boundaries of what is possible in a mobile camera. The app offers full manual controls, a more natural ("SLR-like") look, and the highest image quality that computational photography can provide. It also introduces new photographic experiences that are not available in other camera apps. The app, which is available for free on the App Store, went viral after launch, garnering millions of downloads and earning broad positive coverage in the tech press. Here is a blog about the app.
At present, project Indigo is an experiment – although a very successful one. Our goal is to turn it into an Adobe product., with regular releases of new features, a broader OS footprint (Android comes later), and the best possible performance. Note the "What's next?” paragraphs at the end of the blog, which enumerate some of the features we plan to add. To achieve these goals, we are scaling up the team. Come help us build the future of mobile photography!
What will you work on?
While you will have significant ownership in shaping your role within the team, your responsibilities will broadly include API design (evolving existing components and architecting new ones), feature development, performance optimization (at the OS, algorithmic, and GPU levels), debugging (both on-device and through unit testing), staying current with iOS platform developments, reducing technical debt, and contributing to overall UX improvements.

Ability to manage memory effectively, including low-level C++ memory management

A passion for photography

title: Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
description:
As a Mobile Developer (Flutter), you'll be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining high-quality mobile applications that customers, store teams, and partners rely on every day. The role requires strong mobile development fundamentals, problem-solving skills, and the ability to build scalable, user-friendly applications while working closely with the Engineering Lead and cross-functional teams in a fast-moving, build-from-scratch environment.
Responsibilities
Design and develop mobile application features end-to-end using Flutter, working closely with the Engineering Lead on architecture decisions for apps used by customers, store teams, and partners.
Write clean, productive, maintainable, and well-structured code following engineering best practices.
Debug, test, and resolve defects with attention to quality, performance, and user experience.
Stay aligned with product strategy, evaluate feasibility of ideas from PMs, estimate effort, and help plan roadmaps and feature rollouts.
Participate in requirement discussions, sprint ceremonies, and Agile development workflows.
Collaborate effectively with fellow developers, QA, product managers, and cross-functional teams to meet timelines and unblock each other.
Document code, APIs, technical designs, and implementation details to ensure everything you build is scalable and maintainable.
Use AI-assisted tools (e. g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT) responsibly to improve productivity and code quality.
Continuously learn and apply new mobile technologies, frameworks, and industry standards.
Ensure application performance, responsiveness, security, and scalability across mobile platforms critical for users in Tier 3-5 towns with variable network conditions.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
3+ years of strong proficiency in the Flutter and Dart programming languages.
Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving.
Experience developing and deploying mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms.
Good understanding of mobile application architecture patterns (MVC, MVVM, Clean Architecture, etc. ).
Experience consuming REST APIs and integrating third-party SDKs and services.
Understanding of application lifecycle, state management, performance optimization, and debugging techniques.
Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
Understanding of Agile concepts (user stories, backlog, sprints).
A proactive mindset to build things from scratch in an unstructured environment.
High ownership, curiosity, and the ability to balance pragmatism with quality.
Good communication and team collaboration skills; a quick learner with a growth mindset.
Interest in the retail and e-commerce space and building tech that works for small-town India.
Preferred Skills
Experience with state management frameworks such as Provider, Riverpod, Bloc, or similar.
Knowledge of unit testing, widget testing, and mobile automation testing.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for mobile application deployment.
Understanding of mobile app publishing processes for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Experience with mobile application security best practices.
Prior experience building apps for low-connectivity or offline-first environments.
This job was posted by Koushal Gada from SuperK.
